content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Unsupervised anomaly detection methods such as one-class SVMs, Isolation Forest, and kernel density estimators can exploit statistical properties of ICS traffic like determinism and periodicity to identify deviations from normal baseline behaviour without labelled attack data.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10477","field":"abstract","quote":"unsupervised methods. Covered algorithms include univariate control charts, multivariate Gaussian models, kernel density estimators, one-class SVMs, Isolation Forest"},{"id":"R1008","field":"keywords","quote":"anomaly detection, one-class classification, statistical baseline modelling"}]},{"text":"Protocol-agnostic byte-level feature extraction from raw application payloads can detect anomalies in Modbus and other ICS traffic with one-class SVM and Isolation Forest achieving AUROC above 0.87 even without protocol-specific parsers.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10483","field":"abstract","quote":"A one-class SVM and an Isolation Forest were trained on mixed-protocol captures from a testbed running Modbus, DNP3"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10483","field":"abstract","quote":"Against seven attack scenarios including vendor-protocol-specific command injection, the protocol-agnostic detectors achieved AUROC values of 0.89 and 0.87 respectively"}]},{"text":"Statistical baseline modelling approaches are suitable for embedded deployment on constrained hardware and address evaluation challenges including scarcity of labelled datasets and the trade-off between false alarm rate and response latency.","sources":[{"id":"R1008","field":"bio","quote":"lightweight online learning algorithms suited to constrained embedded environments"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10477","field":"abstract","quote":"The chapter closes with a discussion of evaluation methodology challenges, including the scarcity of labelled datasets, the difficulty of representative attack injection, and the trade-off between false alarm rate and response latency"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's work directly addresses the core challenge: unsupervised one-class classification and statistical baseline modelling for Modbus and BACnet-family protocols without labelled attack examples [R1008, SYN-PUB-10477], with proven methods for embedded inference [R1008] and empirically validated protocol-agnostic detection achieving high accuracy [SYN-PUB-10483]."}
